The news was passed down layer by layer. The forces that were further away from the center of the war would take longer to receive the news. For example, the rogue warlord forces with limited information channels were considered to be the forces that received the news very late. The Overmera was one of them.

As Theseus's partner, the Overmera family did not participate in the war directly. Instead, they were responsible for maintaining the stability of the Northern Continent. This was also an opportunity for the Overmera to develop. The Dark Net's sanctuary plan inspired many warlords. Some of the warlord forces also started to try to build something similar. Their original intention was not to protect people like Bennett but to benefit from it and gain more labor.

Now that the Overmera family was led by the Xiao Faction, Xiao Jin took the opportunity of Black Phantom's visit to do whatever he wanted. Xiao Hai admired his father's methods very much. Although sometimes when he thought of Black Phantom as his godfather, it was like swallowing a lump of sh * t, Black Phantom had not appeared for a long time, and this made Xiao Hai feel much better.

In the study of the mansion, Xiao Hai finished reporting the recent events. Seeing Xiao Jin deep in thought, he could not help but ask, "Father, you don't seem to be satisfied with the current situation?"

Xiao Jin glanced at him. "I haven't gained a firm foothold yet. I'm still being controlled by others."

"You mean Black Phantom?" Xiao Hai did not understand. "Although part of your position is due to Black Phantom, the power belongs to us. He's not here, so he can't exert too much influence on us."

"This happens to be where my weakness is. Black Phantom let me get the position of the head of the family, but his influence is limited. He can't control our internal decisions. The other factions seem to respect me on the surface, but in reality, they're just following my orders. Our position is not stable, so we can only use the power of the Xiao Faction. The other factions have been avoiding and not contributing, so it's difficult for us to make decisions."

Xiao Jin thought of Han Xiao's threat and added, "Black Phantom is not easy to deal with, and I paid the price. [Love ↑ go △ little ↑ say △ w]

】”As he spoke, Xiao Jin stood up and took out a glass of precious Red Maple Gold Leaf wine from the wine cabinet. He poured two glasses, passed one to Xiao Hai, and took a sip of the other. He slowly said, "Let's not talk about these. There is still a thorn stuck in the throat of the Xiao Faction. Your brother Xiao Han is a wanted criminal of the Germinal Organization. This is a hidden danger. Theseus's people have come to us more than once to collect relevant information. Now that the war is at its climax, all the forces are trying their best to wash away their ties with the Germinal Organization, but we can't do that unless we find him and hand him over to the Six Nations."At the mention of his younger brother, Xiao Hai's expression became unnatural. Ever since he found out that Xiao Han, whom he had tricked, was still alive, he had been worried."I heard that Zero is inextricably linked to the current situation of the Germinal Organization …" Xiao Hai had mixed feelings. He was the one who did not want to see Xiao Han succeed the most. He was afraid of revenge. Although he had grown up with his younger brother and knew his weak personality very well, he could not ignore the possibility of his younger brother's personality changing drastically.What Zero had done was obviously not something that his cowardly younger brother could do. Thinking of this, Xiao Hai was very worried about revenge, although he still did not know what kind of person his younger brother had become.Knock, knock. There was a knock on the door. The assistant poked his head in and said carefully, "Leader, Se Qi is here to visit."Se Qi was the leader of the Overmera Red Island Faction. He had always been unhappy with Xiao Jin being the leader."Let him in."Xiao Jin frowned, put down the glass, and said slowly, "Ever since I was elected as the leader, he has not come to visit me. There must be something wrong."Xiao Hai nodded and stood aside to wait.After waiting for a while, Se Qi strode in with a hearty smile on his face. As soon as he entered the door, he said loudly, "Leader."Xiao Jin did not change his expression. He nodded and invited Se Qi to sit. Xiao Hai secretly sized him up. Seeing that Se Qi's face had a hint of flattery, he could not help but feel strange.This natural and warm look did not seem like a person who was at odds with his father.Se Qi took out a plan. This was a plan of action by Xiao Jin that required the power of the Red Island Faction. Se Qi had been avoiding it for a while, but now he took it out and said shyly, "I have been thinking about it for a while. This plan is very useful, and I am willing to contribute. This time, I want to discuss the specific details. Don't worry, I will definitely have someone to contribute."Xiao Hai was pleasantly surprised and thought to himself, The Red Island Faction has given in and officially acknowledged the position of the Xiao Faction!Xiao Jin was also a little surprised. He nodded slowly and began to discuss with Se Qi. 】”

As he spoke, Xiao Jin stood up and took out a glass of precious Red Maple Gold Leaf wine from the wine cabinet. He poured two glasses, passed one to Xiao Hai, and took a sip of the other. He slowly said, "Let's not talk about these. There is still a thorn stuck in the throat of the Xiao Faction. Your brother Xiao Han is a wanted criminal of the Germinal Organization. This is a hidden danger. Theseus's people have come to us more than once to collect relevant information. Now that the war is at its climax, all the forces are trying their best to wash away their ties with the Germinal Organization, but we can't do that unless we find him and hand him over to the Six Nations."

At the mention of his younger brother, Xiao Hai's expression became unnatural. Ever since he found out that Xiao Han, whom he had tricked, was still alive, he had been worried.

"I heard that Zero is inextricably linked to the current situation of the Germinal Organization …" Xiao Hai had mixed feelings. He was the one who did not want to see Xiao Han succeed the most. He was afraid of revenge. Although he had grown up with his younger brother and knew his weak personality very well, he could not ignore the possibility of his younger brother's personality changing drastically.

What Zero had done was obviously not something that his cowardly younger brother could do. Thinking of this, Xiao Hai was very worried about revenge, although he still did not know what kind of person his younger brother had become.

Knock, knock. There was a knock on the door. The assistant poked his head in and said carefully, "Leader, Se Qi is here to visit."

Se Qi was the leader of the Overmera Red Island Faction. He had always been unhappy with Xiao Jin being the leader.

"Let him in." Xiao Jin frowned, put down the glass, and said slowly, "Ever since I was elected as the leader, he has not come to visit me. There must be something wrong."

Xiao Hai nodded and stood aside to wait.

After waiting for a while, Se Qi strode in with a hearty smile on his face. As soon as he entered the door, he said loudly, "Leader."

Xiao Jin did not change his expression. He nodded and invited Se Qi to sit. Xiao Hai secretly sized him up. Seeing that Se Qi's face had a hint of flattery, he could not help but feel strange. This natural and warm look did not seem like a person who was at odds with his father.

Se Qi took out a plan. This was a plan of action by Xiao Jin that required the power of the Red Island Faction. Se Qi had been avoiding it for a while, but now he took it out and said shyly, "I have been thinking about it for a while. This plan is very useful, and I am willing to contribute. This time, I want to discuss the specific details. Don't worry, I will definitely have someone to contribute."

Xiao Hai was pleasantly surprised and thought to himself, The Red Island Faction has given in and officially acknowledged the position of the Xiao Faction!

Xiao Jin was also a little surprised. He nodded slowly and began to discuss with Se Qi.
